# FQ-COMMUTATOR-TRACE-OBSTRUCTION

The new Lean theorem covers every positive finite dimension over Q: AB-BA=lambda I forces lambda=0 by cyclic trace. Native tests retain full commutator arrays in dimensions one, two and three. Finite trace obstruction does not forbid all finite quantum models or approximate/bounded CCR.

Supported: The exact finite-dimensional scalar commutator obstruction is kernel checked for arbitrary n>0 over Q.
